summary: The implementation architecture is now materially frozen around three stable runtime boundaries and a tests boundary. All four explicit acceptance entrypoints exist as read-only executable scripts and were executed successfully through the repository-local real-environment path. Critical architecture guardrails are executable and passing. The remaining Coding/Repair queue is limited to unfinished support-test executable coverage for mediator preemption and a repository validation-script module-format defect.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Mediator outcome and structured Blender feedback expose a thinking-compatible state.
Mediator outcome and structured Blender feedback expose a confirming-compatible state.
Mediator outcome surfaces degradation and neutral-idle recovery.
The semantic control result exposes action 'thinking' and structured Blender feedback with a thinking-compatible state.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Architecture boundary guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: No direct import from src/blender-bridge appears in the runtime layer.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Semantic control boundary guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read scripts/control-avatar.mjs as the current host-owned semantic control asset.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The control asset delegates semantic execution through the runtime/mediator boundary instead of launching scripts/blender-adapter.mjs directly.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Dependency direction guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read src/blender-bridge/index.ts and src/avatar-mediator/index.ts import surfaces.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Bridge has no reverse import to runtime or mediator, and mediator imports the bridge contract only.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Explicit entrypoint guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Resolve explicit testcase files and protected baseline fixture keys.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: All four explicit test entrypoints and their baseline metadata exist in the repository.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: User semantic entrypoint guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Invoke scripts/control-avatar.mjs --intent "rotate the right hand bone 30 degrees".
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The semantic control entrypoint exits non-zero and rejects low-level rig control instead of coercing the request into Blender automation.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Traceability guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md and local ARCHITECTURE.md contracts.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts mention the intended stable elements, explicit testcase entrypoints, the user semantic control path, intent element mappings, and bridge-owned Sprite observation binding.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: AcceptanceCriteria script path guard
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read explicit testcase acceptanceCriteria values from design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Each explicit testcase points to an existing single executable script file accepted by the failure-record consumer.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Avatar intent mapping support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Resolve representative natural-language avatar intents, including low-level rig requests, through scripts/avatar-intent-mapping.mjs.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Supported requests resolve to approved semantic actions and low-level rig requests are rejected as unsupported.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Avatar mute override support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The mediator suppresses avatar execution while keeping the runtime control-loop callable.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Lifecycle mapping contract support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Drive response_start and response_complete through AgentRuntime with a recording bridge.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: response_start maps to thinking, response_complete maps to confirming, and both execute against the bridge contract.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Structured feedback fixture support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Create the shared structured feedback fixture.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The fixture exposes acknowledgement, status, observedState, and detail fields.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Sprite visual scene binding support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read scripts/blender-visual-adapter.mjs to inspect the default visual-scene binding contract.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The observation path defaults to assets/sprite.blend for this iteration while preserving explicit override via BLENDER_VISUAL_BLEND_FILE.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Sprite feedback detail contract support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read scripts/blender-visual-driver.py to inspect how Sprite observation detail is emitted.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The existing response shape is preserved, and the detail string names the selected Sprite preset, action family, or equivalent bridge-owned selection detail.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: Preemption policy support guardrail
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Deliver two rapid lifecycle events to the mediator before the earlier avatar motion completes.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The newest semantic action wins and stale motion does not remain the visible outcome.
